name: EPIC 211805473
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 14.3 solar radii and 1.11 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,969 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.11 solar masses and 14.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,533 K at its surface.
